QA Summary - Issue #4: API Publish Channel

Result

Failed. The protected route, validation checks, and FE token flow are present, but a real publish request to a QA-only channel returned HTTP 500. This is a coding/API conditioning bug because the handler collapses Centrifugo upstream failure into a generic internal server error instead of returning a controlled upstream/dependency response. No destructive or persistent data mutation was executed.
